title: A Policy Profile for Croissant: Refusal as a Property of the Dataset
description: An additive policy profile for Croissant dataset descriptors, with a reference implementation, conformance validator, MCP capability projection, measured overhead, a caller-side/data-side precedence experiment, and a tool for re-deciding a stored decision archive against a later policy without re-running it. Deposited in part as a defensive publication: the mechanisms described here are placed in the public record so that they are available to anyone and patentable by no one.
